description: LV2-C1: after a SCARPER! (reactive) normal move is confirmed, the Movement panel must not keep the moved unit's red group-drag hint ('9 of 10 models can be placed here') nor enabled Undo Model / Reset Unit / End This Unit's Move buttons with no unit selected. Same set-up and real clicks as ork11e_scarper (Runt Swarm P2, the Runtherd parked south of the Gretchin; P1's Custodian Guard Gamma ends a move, P2 uses SCARPER! on Gretchin Alpha, D6 = 5" with seed 42). Ctrl+A + a real 3.8" drag south: one Gretchin is blocked by the Runtherd and the hint says so; a real click on End This Unit's Move confirms the reactive move. Then the hint is empty and the three per-unit buttons are disabled; when Player 1 selects the next unit (Custodian Guard Delta, real click) the buttons are enabled again. Setup privilege (WP-FIX1): the dice are re-seeded (RulesEngine.set_test_seed) right before the Use click, so the D6 is 5 regardless of how many RNG instances the engine made since load.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Runt Swarm for P2; Custodian Guard Gamma 11" north of Gretchin Alpha; Runtherd moved aside
Skip Overwatch is on (harness default) — Fire Overwatch is not under test

steps.equals: Custodian Guard Gamma has ended a move

steps.comment: WP-FIX1 setup privilege: re-seed the dice right before SCARPER! is used. The fixture-level rng_seed counts every RNG instance the engine makes from load onwards (instance k is seeded hash([seed, k])). WP-C46's Superior Creation hook no longer makes one on each phase transition, so at the old seed the SCARPER! D6 came up 2 instead of 5. A 2" move cannot reach the Runtherd, so the group-drag hint this scenario checks never appears. Seed chosen so the D6 is 5 again.
up to D6": the move cap is the rolled die
the reactive move owns the phase
r3:F7/r5:F11: the mode chooser (Advance / Remain Still / Confirm Movement Mode) is hidden during the reactive move
the panel names the fixed mode: Normal Move — SCARPER! (up to N")
